description: ROLES of a shot in a reel. A role fixes (1) what the PHOTO must contain so that the clip has something real to move (a person from behind, a foreground layer, the whole mural), and (2) the ONE real motion of the clip: camera + one action (Kling's own guide: 'subject + movement'). The two motions are the ones proven on 05.11 (clip A: locked camera, a person leaves; clip B: first-person walk-in with parallax). Never ordered: plain zoom (CapCut does it free), sideways slide (Kling invents the cropped edge of the mural), tilt/pedestal up, a beam of light (Kling draws only a general brightening). Faces are never shown: a person only from behind, no part of the face even in profile. Placeholders: {person}, {hero} (the hero of the mural, from the listing's `brief.hero`), {door_side} / {cam_side} / {side} / {far_side}; pronouns {her} (his/her), {she} (he/she), {him} (him/her) follow the person, never the kit text. `persons`: a plain string is ONE fixed person (always a woman or a girl); a dict gives one person per child gender (`girl`, `boy`, else `neutral`); `adult_persons` lists the keys that are grown-ups (the director shows a WARNING when an adult is picked by the age of the kit). `ages` of a role: the age bands (baby, vorschul, schulkind) whose kit the role may stand in; `gender` of a role fixes the child.

room.label: Room: no person; the camera move and the light motion come from specs/video_motion.json (a slot may name them: camera, light)
room.framing: Shot from the {cam_side} part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the {side} side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part. Nothing stands in front of the mural and no curtain hangs in the frame.
room.video_why: no person: only the camera and the light move; written 10.11 to be measured on Kling 2.6 against Omni 1.2 (the drift of the mural is what is compared)

hook.label: Hook: a person leaves, the camera is still
hook.photo_scene: At the {door_side} edge of the frame, beside the mural wall, an open white door leads out of the room; {person} stands in the doorway with her back to the camera, one foot on the threshold, carrying a folded blush blanket, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. She stays at the {door_side} edge, well away from the mural.
hook.framing: Shot from the {cam_side} part of the room at eye level, turned about 20 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the {side} side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with the ceiling line above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.
hook.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. {person} at the {door_side} edge of the frame turns away from the camera and steps out through the open white doorway, then pulls the white door closed behind her with a soft natural motion until it is fully shut. Her face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of her head, her hair and her clothes are seen. She stays at the {door_side} edge of the frame, far from {hero}, and never passes in front of the mural. The warm light stays constant.
hook.video_why: a person leaves, from behind: the proven Kling case

product.label: Product: the whole mural, a walk-in with parallax
product.photo_scene: A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme {door_side} edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer.
product.framing: Shot from the {cam_side} part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the {side} side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part. Nothing stands in front of the mural.
product.motion: A smooth slow first-person walk-in: the camera advances steadily straight forward into the room at natural eye level, as if a person is slowly entering, with no sideways drift, no tilt and no rotation. The sheer cream curtain in the extreme foreground on the {door_side} leaves the frame as the camera advances past it, and the nearer objects shift more than the farther ones, giving a natural depth parallax.
product.video_why: walk-in with parallax: proven on Listing 45

life.label: Life: a person from behind does one action, the camera is still

The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.
life.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. {person} {life_action}. {her} face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of {her} head, {her} hair and {her} clothes are seen. {she} stays on the {side} side of the frame, far from {hero}, and never passes in front of the mural. The soft light stays constant.
life.video_why: one action of a person: proven on Listings 2 and 45

play.video_why: default: Grok untested on a seated, calm child (worth one test)

leave.label: Leave: a child walks away from the camera out of the room, the camera and the door are still
leave.photo_scene: At the {door_side} edge of the frame an open white door leads out of the room; {person} stands in the doorway with {her} back to the camera, one foot on the threshold, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural.
leave.framing: Shot from the {cam_side} part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the {side} side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.
leave.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. {person}, standing in the open doorway at the {door_side} edge of the frame with {her} back to the camera, walks away from the camera through the doorway into the next room with calm unhurried steps and goes out of view; the white door stays exactly as it is, open, and {she} does not touch it. {her} face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of {her} head, {her} hair and {her} clothes are seen. {she} stays at the {door_side} edge of the frame, far from {hero}, and never passes in front of the mural. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The warm light stays constant.
leave.video_why: proven on Listing 3 (a child walks away)

run_in.label: Run in: a toddler runs in through the door toward the mural and throws both arms up in delight, the camera is still
run_in.photo_scene: At the {door_side} edge of the frame an open white door leads into the room; {person} has just come through it and stands two steps inside the room at the {door_side} edge of the frame with {her} back to the camera, in mid-stride with both arms swinging out to the sides, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural.
run_in.framing: Shot from the {cam_side} part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the {side} side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.
run_in.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. {person}, standing just inside the open doorway at the {door_side} edge of the frame with {her} back to the camera, runs a few quick happy steps across the floor toward the mural wall and stops about two metres in front of it; on the last step both arms rise high above {her} head in delight and {she} stands still. {her} face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of {her} head, {her} hair and {her} clothes are seen. The white door stays exactly as it is, open. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
run_in.video_why: Grok video is OUT (owner 08.11: the mural moved, a child's body was distorted); Kling 2.6 is the only model for a person. Not tried on this role yet.

wow.label: Wow: a schoolchild with both arms raised takes two slow steps to the mural, lowers one arm and strokes the painted animals with the other hand, the camera is still
wow.photo_scene: {person} stands on the floor in the middle of the room about two and a half metres in front of the mural wall with {her} back to the camera, both arms raised high above {her} head in delight, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural.
wow.framing: Shot from the {cam_side} part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the {side} side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.
wow.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. {person} stands with {her} back to the camera in front of the mural wall, both arms raised. Slowly and calmly {she} takes two small steps toward the wall, {her} left arm lowers to {her} side, and {her} right hand comes to rest lightly on the wall and moves slowly along it from the giraffe toward the elephant, as if stroking the painted animals. {her} body moves very little, the movement stays gentle and unhurried, and {she} stops at the wall. {her} face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of {her} head, {her} hair and {her} clothes are seen. The rug and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
wow.video_why: Grok video is OUT (owner 08.11: the mural moved, a child's body was distorted); Kling 2.6 is the only model for a person. Not tried on this role yet.

gaze.label: Gaze: a child already points up at the big balloon, takes one small step toward the mural, the camera is still
gaze.photo_scene: {person} stands on the floor in the middle of the room about two metres in front of the mural wall with {her} back to the camera, one arm raised and pointing up at {gaze_target}, {her} head tilted back to look up at it, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural.

The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.
gaze.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. {person} stands with {her} back to the camera in front of the mural wall, {her} right arm already raised and pointing up at {gaze_target}, {her} head tilted back looking up at it. Slowly and calmly {she} takes one small step toward the wall while {her} arm stays raised and keeps pointing at {gaze_target} and {her} gaze stays on it. {her} body moves very little. Only the back of {her} head, {her} hair and {her} clothes are seen, and {her} head stays turned toward the wall. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
gaze.video_why: Grok video is OUT (owner 08.11: the mural moved, a child's body was distorted); Kling 2.6 is the only model for a person. Not tried on this role yet.
